caveats: The official Wizards articles document each named set's collectible art-card component; they do not print Scryfall's art-series grouping codes (e.g., AZNR) as official separate product set codes.

Modern Horizons 2019 release notes expressly say art cards are not Magic cards for gameplay. Other entries are artwork collectibles or booster inserts, not new deckbuilding-card designs or standalone premier sets.

Art-card insertion slots varied by year and product: original boosters, Set Boosters, Play Boosters, Beyond Boosters and later Collector Boosters are different distribution contexts. Do not generalize one article's slot percentage to other years.

The Midnight Hunt entry is a first-party set product-page inclusion claim, a lower-granularity evidence grade than dedicated official galleries. No collector-number completeness is certified for that entry.

Of 41 source-pending frozen Scryfall Art Series codes, Avatar original/eternal art sets ATLA and ATLE, and The Hobbit Eternal AHOC, remain pending because these particular subgroup boundaries lack independent direct Wizards corroboration.
The snapshot records remain frozen to October 29, 2026. No card IDs, printing date, Scryfall parent links, actual game legality, or all-time premier-set count is rewritten.
